001package com.streamconverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamconverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
006import com.streamconverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
007import com.streamconverter.context.PipelineContext;
008import com.streamconverter.path.CSVPath;
009import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
010import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015import org.slf4j.MDC;
016
017/**
018 * StreamConverterのMDC伝搬デモ
019 *
020 * <p>このデモでは、親スレッドで設定したMDC値がStreamConverter配下の 全コマンドに自動的に伝搬されることを示します。
021 */
022public class StreamConverterMDCDemo {
023  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamConverterMDCDemo.class);
024
025  /**
026   * Main method to demonstrate StreamConverter MDC propagation.
027   *
028   * @param args command line arguments (not used)
029   * @throws IOException if file operations fail
030   */
031  public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
032    logger.info("StreamConverter MDC Propagation Demo");
033
034    demonstrateBasicMDC();
035    demonstrateMultipleCommandsMDC();
036    demonstrateChildToChildPropagation();
037
038    logger.info("All demonstrations completed successfully!");
039  }
040
041  /** デモ1: 基本的なMDC伝搬 */
042  private static void demonstrateBasicMDC() throws IOException {
043    logger.info("Demo 1: Basic MDC Propagation");
044
045    // 親スレッドでMDCを設定
046    MDC.put("requestId", "REQ-DEMO-456");
047    MDC.put("userId", "demo-user");
048
049    try {
050      IStreamCommand command = (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out);
051      StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(command);
052
053      String testData = "id,name,department\n1,Alice,Engineering\n2,Bob,Marketing\n";
054      ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
055          new ByteArrayInputStream(testData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
056      ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
057
058      logger.info("Executing pipeline with MDC propagation...");
059      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
060
061      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
062      logger.info("Demo 1 completed. Output length: {} characters", result.length());
063    } finally {
064      MDC.clear();
065    }
066  }
067
068  /** デモ2: コマンド間MDC伝搬（PipelineContext） */
069  private static void demonstrateChildToChildPropagation() throws IOException {
070    logger.info("Demo 2: Child-to-Child MDC Propagation via PipelineContext");
071
072    MDC.put("requestId", "REQ-CHILD-001");
073
074    try {
075      // Command A: ストリームデータからIDを抽出してPipelineContextに設定
076      IStreamCommand extractId =
077          (in, out) -> {
078            byte[] data = in.readAllBytes();
079            String content = new String(data, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
080
081            // 冒頭行からIDを抽出（シミュレーション）
082            String orderId = content.lines().findFirst().orElse("UNKNOWN");
083            PipelineContext.putShared("orderId", orderId);
084            logger.info("Command A: extracted orderId from stream");
085
086            out.write(data);
087          };
088
089      // Command B: TurboFilter経由でorderIdが自動的にMDCに反映される
090      IStreamCommand process =
091          (in, out) -> {
092            // ログ出力時にTurboFilterがPipelineContextの共有値をMDCにsyncする
093            // → このログにorderId が自動的に含まれる
094            logger.info("Command B: processing with orderId automatically in MDC");
095            in.transferTo(out);
096          };
097
098      StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(extractId, process);
099
100      String testData = "ORD-2026-0001\nitem1,100\nitem2,200\n";
101      ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
102          new ByteArrayInputStream(testData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
103      ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
104
105      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
106      logger.info("Demo 2 completed. Output size: {} bytes", outputStream.size());
107    } finally {
108      MDC.clear();
109    }
110  }
111
112  /** デモ3: 複数コマンドでのMDC伝搬 */
113  private static void demonstrateMultipleCommandsMDC() throws IOException {
114    logger.info("Demo 3: Multiple Commands with MDC Propagation");
115
116    MDC.put("requestId", "REQ-MULTI-789");
117
118    try {
119      String testData = "product,price,category\nLaptop,999.99,Electronics\nBook,19.99,Education\n";
120
121      // 複数のコマンドでパイプライン構築
122      IStreamCommand validator = (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out);
123      CsvNavigateCommand extractor =
124          CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("product"), new PassThroughRule());
125      IStreamCommand formatter = (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out);
126
127      StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(validator, extractor, formatter);
128
129      ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
130          new ByteArrayInputStream(testData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
131      ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
132
133      logger.info("Executing multi-command pipeline with MDC propagation...");
134      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
135
136      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
137      logger.info("Demo 3 completed. Final output: {}", result.trim());
138    } finally {
139      MDC.clear();
140    }
141  }
142}
